short_description: Two-hour sightseeing cruise from Goodland through the Ten Thousand Islands to Marco Island with a certified naturalist guide.
description: This popular two-hour sightseeing cruise travels from Goodland through the mangrove estuary of the Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge to Marco Island and back. A Florida-certified master naturalist guide, who is also a member of the Marco Island Historical Society, provides entertaining commentary on local history, ecology and coastal life. Expect discussion of the Calusa Indians, Cape Romano, island development, waterfront culture and regional wildlife, with good opportunities to spot dolphins, manatees and birds along the route.

what_is_included_items.value: Guided narration by Florida-certified master naturalists

itinerary:
1. Depart our private dock in Goodland
2. See the "drinking village with a fishing problem" of Goodland
3. See all the waterfront restaurants and bars
4. Head out into the 10,000 Islands to look for dolphins and wildlife
5. Enjoy beautiful naturescapes of Marco Island such as the Caxambas sandbars and the beachfront from Cape Marco
6. Cruise through the Marco Estates to see lavish waterfront mansions
7. Enjoy a winding route back through the mangroves from Marco to Goodland
highlights:
* Expert naturalist-guided tour focused on history, ecology and local culture
* Travel through the mangrove nearshore estuary of the Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge
* Good opportunities to see dolphins, manatees and native birdlife
